pr_body:
This branch builds on @adelowo project work in #8346. It implements:

- [X] order columns and issues and remember order after refresh
- [X] make it possible to see issue details in sidebar when clicking on it without leaving project page
- [X] make it possible to add new issues to project without leaving project page.

[Here is the youtube demo to get an idea](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sp8-0Z39GgA)

[![](https://img.youtube.com/vi/sp8-0Z39GgA/0.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sp8-0Z39GgA)

Let me know what you think.
